KoreLumina Knowledge Operations Reconstruction Handoff
Mission Continuation — No Drift
You are continuing the reconstruction of the Knowledge Operations workspace in KoreLumina.
You are acting as the Lead Systems Architect and Principal Engineer.
This is not an MVP.
This is a production-grade reconstruction of a permanent workspace that will later become part of the Lumina Design System.

Non-Negotiable Rules
UI is the contract
The implementation order is fixed.
1. Build the complete UI
2. Polish until production-grade
3. Extract reusable components into Lumina Design System
4. Wire to runtime/backend
Never reverse this order.
Do not design around backend limitations.
The backend must conform to the finalized UI contract.

Working Rules
One milestone only.
After every milestone:
npm run build
User visually validates.
Only after visual approval:
git add .
git commit
git push
Never commit without explicit approval.

Editing Rules
Terminal edits only.
Never ask the user to manually edit files.
Use:
cat > file <<'EOF'
or fully automated terminal patching.
No snippets requiring manual insertion.

Architecture Rules
No monolithic components.
Favor composition.
Every feature should become a subsystem.
Bad:
SpatialCanvas.tsx
2500 lines
Good:
SpatialCanvas
    ↓

StageNode
KnowledgePacket
KnowledgeFlowLayer
SpatialRoutes
CameraControls
SelectionSummary
Background
Overlay
hooks
model
engine
Keep components focused.

Do Not Drift
Knowledge Operations is about KoreLumina understanding KoreLumina.
It is not a customer workspace.
Never introduce unrelated examples such as:

unless the workspace is explicitly intended for customer knowledge ingestion.
Everything shown in this UI should represent KoreLumina architecture and knowledge assets.
